body:
Source: GitHub issue #815 (bug, security, P1-high, area:plugins; class false-green). Re-verified on main @ 5343b84b: plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs:170 `export function resolveOwning(payload, filePath, fallback = process.cwd())` (and resolveRoot at :197). ROOT_KEYS (:57) is payload-only; CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR is consulted only in plugins/adlc-cursor/lib/workspace-resolve.mjs:88. The hook command is `node ./hooks/adlc-pretool.mjs`, so the hook process cwd is the plugin directory. A preToolUse payload without workspace_roots/cwd/root makes railPreconditions evaluate the plugin dir, detectTicketStore throws STORE_NOT_FOUND, state degrades to inactive, and the guard returns {"permission":"allow"} with no stderr, even with ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT=1 and a frozen rail. Repro from the issue: same payload with workspace_roots -> deny; without workspace_roots and cwd = plugin dir -> allow. ADR-0006 (T64 item 2) requires "host-supplied workspace_roots + CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR only; never silent plugin-cwd fallback".

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Plugin `plugins/adlc-cursor`: hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs (decide, resolveOwning, resolveRoot, railPreconditions; the no-path opaque-mutator branch already fails closed under ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT=1, copy its direction and notice style), hooks/adlc-pretool.mjs (calls resolveOwning at :244), hooks/adlc-audit.mjs (calls resolveOwning at :40), lib/workspace-resolve.mjs (normalizeRootPath and the CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR handling at :88; reuse by import, do not edit). Fixtures in plugins/adlc-cursor/test/fixtures/ all supply workspace_roots. Tests: run the plugin suite with `node scripts/run-tests.mjs cursor` (segments `cursor` and `cursor install smoke`) and `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/<file>.test.mjs` for one file. plugins/adlc-cursor/test/rails-guard.test.mjs and pretool-dispatch.test.mjs are NOT rails and may change.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. resolveOwning and resolveRoot never default to process.cwd(). The default fallback becomes the host-supplied project dir: CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR from the environment, normalized with the already-exported normalizeRootPath from lib/workspace-resolve.mjs (import it; that file is a rail and is not edited). The env is read through an injectable parameter so tests do not mutate process.env. An explicit fallback argument from a caller is still honored.
2. When no root resolves (no payload root key, no CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR), resolveOwning returns root null. decide() then: with ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT=1, returns a deny whose message says the workspace root could not be resolved from the hook payload or CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR; without enforcement, returns allow and writes one stderr notice naming the same cause. adlc-pretool.mjs and adlc-audit.mjs handle a null root without throwing and without evaluating the plugin directory.
3. Regression guard: every existing payload that supplies workspace_roots/cwd/root decides exactly as today; a payload without root keys but with CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR set to the repo resolves the repo and denies the frozen-rail edit.
4. Documentation: update `plugins/adlc-cursor/README.md` and make the SAME edit by hand in `apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/cursor.mdx` (hand-maintained mirror; never regenerate). State the root-resolution order (payload root keys, then CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR, never the plugin cwd) and the fail-closed behaviour under ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT=1.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Driving the shipped hook (spawn `node plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks/adlc-pretool.mjs` with cwd = the plugin dir) with a preToolUse edit of a frozen rail, no root keys in the payload, no CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR, and ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT=1 yields a non-allow permission with the unresolved-root reason. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/rails-guard-no-root.test.mjs`
- AC2 The same payload with CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR = the temp repo yields deny for the frozen rail (the rail reason, not the unresolved-root one). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/rails-guard-no-root.test.mjs`
- AC3 Without enforcement and no resolvable root: allow plus exactly one stderr notice naming the cause. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/rails-guard-no-root.test.mjs`
- AC4 Library level: resolveOwning with no root keys and an empty injected env returns root null and never the process cwd. A new fixture with NO workspace_roots exists under plugins/adlc-cursor/test/fixtures/ and is used by the test. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/rails-guard-no-root.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing plugin suite green, including audit and pretool dispatch. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/rails-guard.test.mjs plugins/adlc-cursor/test/pretool-dispatch.test.mjs plugins/adlc-cursor/test/audit.test.mjs` and the plugin's run-tests segment
- AC6 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c "CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR" plugins/adlc-cursor/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/cursor.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC7 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally)

OUT OF SCOPE: sessionStart, preCompact and the MCP Roots proxy (already compliant), the generated MCP wrapper bundle, other harness plugins' rails guards, live Cursor deny-delivery proof (T68).
title: adlc-cursor: the rails guard never falls back to the plugin cwd; an unresolvable workspace fails closed under enforcement
